name: See
description: A virus has decimated humankind. Those who survived emerged blind. Centuries later when twins are born with the mythic ability to see, their father must protect his tribe against a threatened queen.

videos.title: Godflame
videos.overview: A journey of survival begins when an army of Witchfinders attacks the village of Alkenny.

videos.title: Message in a Bottle
videos.overview: A special gift for the twins sparks tension in the group.

videos.title: Fresh Blood
videos.overview: The twins struggle to keep a secret from their mother.

videos.title: The River
videos.overview: An attack on the village leads to sacrifice and new challenges.

videos.title: Plastic
videos.overview: As Tamacti Jun's army nears Baba and family, Maghra's past comes to light.

videos.title: Silk
videos.overview: Baba and family are betrayed. Queen Kane uses her cunning to face a new conflict.

videos.title: The Lavender Road
videos.overview: The twins reach a crossroads in their journey to the House of Enlightenment.

videos.title: House of Enlightenment
videos.overview: The twins meet Jerlamarel and finally discover the truth.

videos.title: Brothers and Sisters
videos.overview: Baba ventures into hostile territory in search of Haniwa. Queen Kane consecrates a new Payan capital and makes a surprising announcement.

videos.title: Forever
videos.overview: An old enemy comes face-to-face with Baba. Jerlamarel struggles to accept a life without sight.

videos.title: The Compass
videos.overview: Edo’s leadership is called into question. Baba and Haniwa meet a secret tribe of warriors known as The Compass.

videos.title: The Witchfinder
videos.overview: Kofun and Toad arrive in Pennsa just as Maghra makes a life-changing decision. Baba, Paris, and Haniwa run into a trusted friend.

videos.title: The Dinner Party
videos.overview: Baba and his family are finally reunited, but his joy is cut short when he learns about the queen's plans.

videos.title: The Truth About Unicorns
videos.overview: Maghra, Lord Harlan, and Baba head to the peace summit. Haniwa warns them about Paris' vision. The queen and Kofun spend the day together.

videos.title: The Queen's Speech
videos.overview: Queen Kane's treachery forces Maghra's hand. Kofun gets upsetting news. Haniwa makes a final plea to Wren in a bid for peace.

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye
videos.overview: Baba and Edo lead their armies into an epic battle that builds to an intense face-off between the brothers.

videos.title: Heavy Hangs the Head
videos.overview: Baba embraces life in the mountains as hatred for the sighted grows in Pennsa. A Trivantian scientist develops a terrifying new weapon.

videos.title: Watch Out for Wolves
videos.overview: After a devastating loss, Baba heads to Pennsa to warn his family. Maghra debates the Witchfinders’ fate. Wren stages a daring escape.

videos.title: This Land Is Your Land
videos.overview: Wren arrives in Pennsa and shares information about Tormada’s plans. Tamacti Jun tries once more to quell the Witchfinders’ insurgency.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: Tormada presents his new weaponry to The Triangle as Baba leads a group to the House of Enlightenment to destroy Tormada’s arsenal.

videos.title: The House of Enlightenment
videos.overview: A standoff at the House of Enlightenment gives way to a bloody siege between Baba’s party and Tormada’s soldiers.

videos.title: The Lowlands
videos.overview: Baba and his group take a dangerous shortcut through the lowlands to get to Pennsa. Maghra and Tamacti Jun make a horrifying discovery.

videos.title: God Thunder
videos.overview: Tormada and Sibeth launch a violent attack on Pennsa that puts Maghra and the city’s inhabitants in grave danger.

videos.title: I See You
videos.overview: Baba and Ranger infiltrate Sibeth’s camp, determined to stop her and Tormada once and for all.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 8 wins & 12 nominations total
